## Resources

- [Tidyverse style guide](https://style.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"}: Rules for naming, spacing, line width and code structure in R.
- [How to name files](https://speakerdeck.com/jennybc/how-to-name-files){target="_blank"}: Short talk by Jenny Bryan on machine and human readable file names.
- [What They Forgot to Teach You About R](https://rstats.wtf/){target="_blank"}: Book on project-oriented workflows, file paths and other practical R habits.
